patch_description: This constructor uses a deterministic portfolio of asymmetric hexagonal/contact-graph seeds rather than relying on a small fixed set of row layouts. Each seed is optimized by analytic-Jacobian SQP, then its centers are reweighted using an exact fixed-center linear program for the radii and polished again. The LP stage prevents SQP radius drift from selecting a suboptimal radius allocation for an otherwise good contact geometry. A final common safety scaling certifies containment and non-overlap without the avoidable losses caused by sequential pairwise shrinking.
